rationale: Archive and exclude the generic Energy Storage row because no legal entity or unified CIP platform with that name was verified. Beehive, Scatter Wash, Goldendale and Swan Lake North are separate projects and SPVs with different CI IV or CI V histories. Remove the umbrella ownership period and preserve those projects as separate canonical records without fabricating a cross-project cap table.

supports: The cited storage holdings are separate CI V assets
Goldendale has its own project identity and history

afterImage.name: Energy Storage
afterImage.description: Archived repository umbrella formerly used to group unrelated Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners energy-storage assets. Direct sources identify Beehive Energy Storage, Scatter Wash Energy Storage, Goldendale and Swan Lake North as separate projects and legal SPVs, with different CI IV or CI V fund histories and no common company, unified cap table or manager-level platform named Energy Storage. The umbrella is therefore excluded from the PortCo census and carries no ownership period. The four underlying project records remain separate; this archived row does not merge, replace or infer ownership across them. No sale or signed pending transaction of a unified Energy Storage company was found because no such company was verified.

milestones.event: CI IV acquired the distinct Swan Lake North and Goldendale pumped-storage projects; the transaction did not create a company named Energy Storage.
CI V acquired the distinct Scatter Wash battery project, which later entered operation; it remained a project/SPV rather than part of a unified Energy Storage company.
CI V acquired 100% of the distinct Beehive battery project; it remained a project/SPV rather than part of a unified Energy Storage company.
